dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior end of the visible frame.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency grey clusters distributed primarily in the vicinity of the blowhole and the upper dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the pigmented grey patches and the lighter baseline skin tone.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of a singular, distinct dark circular disruption (blowhole) and minor scattered dark pixels of ambiguous origin.
